(2) 7.9-way average shared memory bank conflicts (69.4% of all shared load wavefronts are excess) cause MIO scoreboard stalls accounting for 45.9% of all stall cycles. The grid of 90 blocks on 132 SMs means only 0.23 waves — many SMs are completely idle. On H200 (Hopper sm_90), replacing scalar pointer arithmetic with tl.make_block_ptr + tl.load enables TMA hardware descriptors, offloading address generation from SM ALUs, reducing register pressure, and enabling asynchronous bulk copies. Simultaneously reducing BLOCK_M 64->32 and BLOCK_N 128->64 cuts register file footprint per thread, allowing more warps/SM and improving occupancy.
